{{Otheruses|Dwartii}}
{{Quote|Over the centuries many challenges have been employed to assess this ability in the Trial of Insight. These include locating a single grain of sand within a field of stones, determining the content and meaning of a fragmentary text from scattered pieces, and solving any of the High Riddles of Dwartii&mdash;and no, researching the riddles in the Archives beforehand is not permitted.|Restelly Quist, ''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force''|<ref name="The Jedi Path">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>}}
The '''High Riddles of Dwartii''' were a set of riddles<ref name="The Jedi Path" /> that shared their name with the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Dwartii system/Legends|Dwartii system]]<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> as well as the group of [[Philosopher/Legends|philosophers]] and lawgivers known as the [[Four Sages of Dwartii/Legends|Four Sages of Dwartii]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|292|Four Sages of Dwartii}}</ref> As a means of assessment in the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trial of Insight]]&mdash;a Jedi Trial which sought to test one's ability to overcome illusion and discern the truth of a matter&mdash;one challenge [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] could face was solving a High Riddle of Dwartii, without prior research of it in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]].<ref name="The Jedi Path" /> At some point by [[990 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2010/12/endnotes-for-star-wars-jedi-path-part-1.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: The Jedi Path (part 1 of 4)|quote=Okay, so we've established that this particular copy of the book dates from 115 BBY. But the content inside is [&hellip;] dating from the year 990 BBY.}}</ref> [[Chief Librarian/Legends|Chief Librarian]] [[Restelly Quist/Legends|Restelly Quist]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] authored a chapter devoted to the Jedi Trials for the [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi trainee]] [[Book/Legends|guidebook]] ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''. In that chapter, she noted the riddles' role in the Trial of Insight.<ref name="The Jedi Path" />

==Behind the scenes==
The High Riddles of Dwartii were mentioned in [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']], a [[2010]] reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="The Jedi Path" />
